title: Bay Area fans left stunned as Lionel Richie, Earth, Wind & Fire concert called off over medical emergency moments before showtime
description: A medical scare involving a member of Earth, Wind & Fire forced Lionel Richie’s San Francisco concert to be postponed Thursday night, leaving fans waiting outside the Chase Center just minutes before the show was set to begin. The arena announced the sudden delay shortly after 7:20 p.m., just before the scheduled 7:30 p.m. start...

title: Panthers rally past Cardinals in Hall of Fame Game to open NFL preseason
description: Haynes King's rushing touchdown on the final play capped a stellar debut, but Carson Beck's sharp passing kept the Cardinals competitive throughout.

title: Two dead, including gunman, at school shooting in Thailand, officials say
description: A teacher was killed and four other people injured in a shooting at a school in Thailand, where the gunman - a student - has killed himself,
